name: Love and Demons
source:
Love and Demons is an hilarious Isekai Parody Visual Novel where you control the fate of Maximillian, a young and naive prince who accidentally enters a portal and finds himself in a mysterious and dangerous demon realm. With multiple paths, endings and an unique Dice Rolling System your choices will determine Max's destiny.

[Edited from [url=https://waifuproduction.itch.io/love-and-demons]itch.io[/url]]
